name: More Good Reviews
description:
More Good Reviews helps businesses get more reviews and keep track of what customers are saying, all in one place.

Track your reputation: see how many reviews you're getting, your average rating, and where they're coming from, like Google, Yelp, or Facebook. Spot problems early, like a drop in ratings, and get actionable next steps on where to improve.

Send review requests: ask for a review by email or text without leaving the chat. See who you've already asked, check if they opened or clicked the message, and follow up with anyone who hasn't responded yet.

_published_faq.name: How do I add More Good Reviews to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add More Good Reviews to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.moregoodreviews.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the More Good Reviews MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: More Good Reviews lists 43 MCP tools, including archiveCustomer, cancelCustomerUnsentMessages, createAsk, createCharge, createCustomer, createLocation, createReviewShareImage, createSource, createTag, deleteCharge, deleteCustomer, and deleteLocation.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to More Good Reviews?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to More Good Reviews in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does More Good Reviews MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: More Good Reviews requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
More Good Reviews is developed by More Good Reviews. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
